errors: verifier_unresolved:n1:No candidate adequately captures 'chest X-ray findings suggestive of mesothelioma'. The procedure concept (Plain X-ray of chest) is the investigation itself, not a finding. The disorder candidates (pleural effusion, pleural thickening) are individual diagnoses rather than imaging finding concepts, and none is specific to the mesothelioma-suggestive imaging pattern. A finding-semantic concept representing abnormal chest X-ray or pleural abnormality on imaging is needed.

verifier_unresolved:action:None of the supplied action candidates match the required action. All candidates are fast-track referrals for other cancer types (colorectal, lung, gynaecological, breast, urological). Selecting 'Fast track referral for suspected lung cancer' would misrepresent the NICE recommendation, which specifically refers to mesothelioma. A mesothelioma-specific suspected cancer pathway referral concept should be sought.

errors: verifier_unresolved:n1:No single candidate adequately represents 'blood test results suggestive of myeloma' as a composite clinical criterion. A finding or situation concept representing suspected myeloma or laboratory findings consistent with myeloma would be more faithful.
